title: The twelve standard terms can never be edited, renamed or deleted
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • All twelve standard terms are active and COD is the default for new customers.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 30" row.
  2. Press Escape.
  3. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Credit Hold" row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu has no "Edit" and no "Delete Credit Term".
  • Step 2: the menu closes.
  • Step 3: the menu has no "Edit" and no "Delete Credit Term".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • Out of Scope: “Editing, renaming or deleting the twelve standard terms. Their names are already on every shop's invoices and in every connected QuickBooks file, and QuickBooks cannot rename a term; shops that want different wording create their own term.”
  • S2-N1: “Standard terms never show "Edit" or "Delete Credit Term".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf): canvas pages "1 List and row menus", "3 New credit term and Inactive tab", "4 Everything deactivated and an empty tab" (the pages the PRD names for this story). The design (read in full on 23 Oct 2026) does not draw this case's screen or state, so no design picture is attached; the expected results above come from the PRD.
